timeline.description: Approaching southwest of Puri over open Bay of Bengal

directives.failure_mode: Complete de-energization of primary transmission feeder. 3 substations tripped due to surge/wind.
directives.recommended_action: Isolate 33kV outdoor switchyard busbars at Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation to prevent short-circuit explosion. Mobilize 500kVA mobile diesel generators from Cuttack Disaster Reserve Depot to downstream healthcare facilities.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Prevents catastrophic transformer blowout; saves estimated 4 to 6 weeks of post-cyclone grid rebuilding time.

vernacular_broadcast.english: PRIORITY 1: Switchyard trip at Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation. Emergency mobile generators deployed to critical hospital feeders.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଜରୁରୀ ସୂଚନା: Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation ଗ୍ରୀଡ୍ ସବ୍‌ଷ୍ଟେସନରେ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ ସରବରାହ ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଛି। ଡାକ୍ତରଖାନା ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ଜରୁରୀ ଜେନେରେଟର ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: प्राथमिकता 1: Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation ग्रिड सबस्टेशन में बिजली आपूर्ति बाधित। अस्पतालों के लिए आपातकालीन मोबाइल जनरेटर रवाना किए गए हैं।

directives.failure_mode: Hospital operating on emergency diesel fuel; primary highway corridor threatened by surge inundation.
directives.recommended_action: Reroute fuel replenishment and high-axle ambulances away from submerged coastal routes. Utilize high-elevation inland bypass (Gop-Nimapada corridor). Preemptively stage oxygen refills on upper floor triage wards.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Maintains continuous ICU and neonatal power; guarantees uninterrupted life-support for over 450 in-patients.

vernacular_broadcast.english: MEDICAL ALERT: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) backup power active. Logistics fuel convoys rerouted via inland high-elevation bypass.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଚିକିତ୍ସା ସତର୍କତା: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) ଜରୁରୀକାଳୀନ ଜେନେରେଟରରେ ଚାଲୁଛି। ଇନ୍ଧନ ଗାଡ଼ିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବନ୍ୟାମୁକ୍ତ ଉଚ୍ଚ ରାସ୍ତା ଦେଇ ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: चिकित्सा अलर्ट: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) बैकअप पावर पर चल रहा है। ईंधन के टैंकरों को बाढ़-मुक्त वैकल्पिक मार्ग से भेजा जा रहा है।

directives.failure_mode: Marine Drive SH-13 impassable due to 1.5m+ coastal surge wash-over. Low-lying fishing settlements at risk.
directives.recommended_action: Halt all civilian vehicular transit along SH-13 immediately. Direct SDRF high-clearance inflatable rescue craft to Chandrabhaga and Astaranga coastal refuge pockets.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Prevents vehicle stranding in surge velocity channels; safely secures 5,000+ coastal residents inside stilted concrete shelters.

vernacular_broadcast.english: EVACUATION NOTICE: Marine Drive highway submerged. Use designated inland elevated trails to reach Chandrabhaga Shelter.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରଣ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ: ସାମୁଦ୍ରିକ ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଜୁଆର ପାଣି ପଶିଛି। ନିକଟସ୍ଥ ବାତ୍ୟା ଆଶ୍ରୟସ୍ଥଳୀକୁ ତୁରନ୍ତ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: निकासी चेतावनी: मरीन ड्राइव मार्ग जलमग्न है। तुरंत नजदीकी पक्के चक्रवात आश्रय स्थल में शरण लें।

directives.recommended_action: Isolate 33kV outdoor switchyard busbars at Paradip Port 132/33kV Substation to prevent short-circuit explosion. Mobilize 500kVA mobile diesel generators from Cuttack Disaster Reserve Depot to downstream healthcare facilities.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Prevents catastrophic transformer blowout; saves estimated 4 to 6 weeks of post-cyclone grid rebuilding time.

vernacular_broadcast.english: PRIORITY 1: Switchyard trip at Paradip Port 132/33kV Substation. Emergency mobile generators deployed to critical hospital feeders.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଜରୁରୀ ସୂଚନା: Paradip Port 132/33kV Substation ଗ୍ରୀଡ୍ ସବ୍‌ଷ୍ଟେସନରେ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ ସରବରାହ ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଛି। ଡାକ୍ତରଖାନା ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ଜରୁରୀ ଜେନେରେଟର ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: प्राथमिकता 1: Paradip Port 132/33kV Substation ग्रिड सबस्टेशन में बिजली आपूर्ति बाधित। अस्पतालों के लिए आपातकालीन मोबाइल जनरेटर रवाना किए गए हैं।

directives.failure_mode: Hospital operating on emergency diesel fuel; primary highway corridor threatened by surge inundation.
directives.recommended_action: Reroute fuel replenishment and high-axle ambulances away from submerged coastal routes. Utilize high-elevation inland bypass (Gop-Nimapada corridor). Preemptively stage oxygen refills on upper floor triage wards.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Maintains continuous ICU and neonatal power; guarantees uninterrupted life-support for over 450 in-patients.

vernacular_broadcast.english: MEDICAL ALERT: Paradip Port Trust Hospital backup power active. Logistics fuel convoys rerouted via inland high-elevation bypass.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଚିକିତ୍ସା ସତର୍କତା: Paradip Port Trust Hospital ଜରୁରୀକାଳୀନ ଜେନେରେଟରରେ ଚାଲୁଛି। ଇନ୍ଧନ ଗାଡ଼ିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବନ୍ୟାମୁକ୍ତ ଉଚ୍ଚ ରାସ୍ତା ଦେଇ ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: चिकित्सा अलर्ट: Paradip Port Trust Hospital बैकअप पावर पर चल रहा है। ईंधन के टैंकरों को बाढ़-मुक्त वैकल्पिक मार्ग से भेजा जा रहा है।

directives.failure_mode: Marine Drive SH-13 impassable due to 1.5m+ coastal surge wash-over. Low-lying fishing settlements at risk.
directives.recommended_action: Halt all civilian vehicular transit along SH-13 immediately. Direct SDRF high-clearance inflatable rescue craft to Chandrabhaga and Astaranga coastal refuge pockets.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Prevents vehicle stranding in surge velocity channels; safely secures 5,000+ coastal residents inside stilted concrete shelters.

vernacular_broadcast.english: EVACUATION NOTICE: Marine Drive highway submerged. Use designated inland elevated trails to reach Chandrabhaga Shelter.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରଣ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ: ସାମୁଦ୍ରିକ ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଜୁଆର ପାଣି ପଶିଛି। ନିକଟସ୍ଥ ବାତ୍ୟା ଆଶ୍ରୟସ୍ଥଳୀକୁ ତୁରନ୍ତ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: निकासी चेतावनी: मरीन ड्राइव मार्ग जलमग्न है। तुरंत नजदीकी पक्के चक्रवात आश्रय स्थल में शरण लें।

vernacular_broadcast.english: PRIORITY 1: Switchyard trip at Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation. Emergency mobile generators deployed to critical hospital feeders.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଜରୁରୀ ସୂଚନା: Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation ଗ୍ରୀଡ୍ ସବ୍‌ଷ୍ଟେସନରେ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ ସରବରାହ ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଛି। ଡାକ୍ତରଖାନା ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ଜରୁରୀ ଜେନେରେଟର ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: प्राथमिकता 1: Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation ग्रिड सबस्टेशन में बिजली आपूर्ति बाधित। अस्पतालों के लिए आपातकालीन मोबाइल जनरेटर रवाना किए गए हैं।

directives.failure_mode: Hospital operating on emergency diesel fuel; primary highway corridor threatened by surge inundation.
directives.recommended_action: Reroute fuel replenishment and high-axle ambulances away from submerged coastal routes. Utilize high-elevation inland bypass (Gop-Nimapada corridor). Preemptively stage oxygen refills on upper floor triage wards.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Maintains continuous ICU and neonatal power; guarantees uninterrupted life-support for over 450 in-patients.

vernacular_broadcast.english: MEDICAL ALERT: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) backup power active. Logistics fuel convoys rerouted via inland high-elevation bypass.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଚିକିତ୍ସା ସତର୍କତା: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) ଜରୁରୀକାଳୀନ ଜେନେରେଟରରେ ଚାଲୁଛି। ଇନ୍ଧନ ଗାଡ଼ିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବନ୍ୟାମୁକ୍ତ ଉଚ୍ଚ ରାସ୍ତା ଦେଇ ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: चिकित्सा अलर्ट: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) बैकअप पावर पर चल रहा है। ईंधन के टैंकरों को बाढ़-मुक्त वैकल्पिक मार्ग से भेजा जा रहा है।

directives.failure_mode: Marine Drive SH-13 impassable due to 1.5m+ coastal surge wash-over. Low-lying fishing settlements at risk.
directives.recommended_action: Halt all civilian vehicular transit along SH-13 immediately. Direct SDRF high-clearance inflatable rescue craft to Chandrabhaga and Astaranga coastal refuge pockets.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Prevents vehicle stranding in surge velocity channels; safely secures 5,000+ coastal residents inside stilted concrete shelters.

vernacular_broadcast.english: EVACUATION NOTICE: Marine Drive highway submerged. Use designated inland elevated trails to reach Chandrabhaga Shelter.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରଣ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ: ସାମୁଦ୍ରିକ ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଜୁଆର ପାଣି ପଶିଛି। ନିକଟସ୍ଥ ବାତ୍ୟା ଆଶ୍ରୟସ୍ଥଳୀକୁ ତୁରନ୍ତ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: निकासी चेतावनी: मरीन ड्राइव मार्ग जलमग्न है। तुरंत नजदीकी पक्के चक्रवात आश्रय स्थल में शरण लें।

vernacular_broadcast.english: PRIORITY 1: Switchyard trip at Paradip Port 132/33kV Substation. Emergency mobile generators deployed to critical hospital feeders.

directives.failure_mode: Hospital operating on emergency diesel fuel; primary highway corridor threatened by surge inundation.

vernacular_broadcast.english: MEDICAL ALERT: Paradip Port Trust Hospital backup power active. Logistics fuel convoys rerouted via inland high-elevation bypass.

directives.failure_mode: Marine Drive SH-13 impassable due to 1.5m+ coastal surge wash-over. Low-lying fishing settlements at risk.

vernacular_broadcast.english: EVACUATION NOTICE: Marine Drive highway submerged. Use designated inland elevated trails to reach Chandrabhaga Shelter.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରଣ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ: ସାମୁଦ୍ରିକ ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଜୁଆର ପାଣି ପଶିଛି। ନିକଟସ୍ଥ ବାତ୍ୟା ଆଶ୍ରୟସ୍ଥଳୀକୁ ତୁରନ୍ତ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: निकासी चेतावनी: मरीन ड्राइव मार्ग जलमग्न है। तुरंत नजदीकी पक्के चक्रवात आश्रय स्थल में शरण लें।

vernacular_broadcast.english: PRIORITY 1: Switchyard trip at Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation. Emergency mobile generators deployed to critical hospital feeders.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଜରୁରୀ ସୂଚନା: Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation ଗ୍ରୀଡ୍ ସବ୍‌ଷ୍ଟେସନରେ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ ସରବରାହ ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଛି। ଡାକ୍ତରଖାନା ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ଜରୁରୀ ଜେନେରେଟର ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: प्राथमिकता 1: Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation ग्रिड सबस्टेशन में बिजली आपूर्ति बाधित। अस्पतालों के लिए आपातकालीन मोबाइल जनरेटर रवाना किए गए हैं।

directives.failure_mode: Hospital operating on emergency diesel fuel; primary highway corridor threatened by surge inundation.
directives.recommended_action: Reroute fuel replenishment and high-axle ambulances away from submerged coastal routes. Utilize high-elevation inland bypass (Gop-Nimapada corridor). Preemptively stage oxygen refills on upper floor triage wards.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Maintains continuous ICU and neonatal power; guarantees uninterrupted life-support for over 450 in-patients.

vernacular_broadcast.english: MEDICAL ALERT: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) backup power active. Logistics fuel convoys rerouted via inland high-elevation bypass.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଚିକିତ୍ସା ସତର୍କତା: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) ଜରୁରୀକାଳୀନ ଜେନେରେଟରରେ ଚାଲୁଛି। ଇନ୍ଧନ ଗାଡ଼ିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବନ୍ୟାମୁକ୍ତ ଉଚ୍ଚ ରାସ୍ତା ଦେଇ ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: चिकित्सा अलर्ट: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) बैकअप पावर पर चल रहा है। ईंधन के टैंकरों को बाढ़-मुक्त वैकल्पिक मार्ग से भेजा जा रहा है।

directives.failure_mode: Marine Drive SH-13 impassable due to 1.5m+ coastal surge wash-over. Low-lying fishing settlements at risk.
directives.recommended_action: Halt all civilian vehicular transit along SH-13 immediately. Direct SDRF high-clearance inflatable rescue craft to Chandrabhaga and Astaranga coastal refuge pockets.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Prevents vehicle stranding in surge velocity channels; safely secures 5,000+ coastal residents inside stilted concrete shelters.

vernacular_broadcast.english: EVACUATION NOTICE: Marine Drive highway submerged. Use designated inland elevated trails to reach Chandrabhaga Shelter.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରଣ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ: ସାମୁଦ୍ରିକ ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଜୁଆର ପାଣି ପଶିଛି। ନିକଟସ୍ଥ ବାତ୍ୟା ଆଶ୍ରୟସ୍ଥଳୀକୁ ତୁରନ୍ତ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: निकासी चेतावनी: मरीन ड्राइव मार्ग जलमग्न है। तुरंत नजदीकी पक्के चक्रवात आश्रय स्थल में शरण लें।

vernacular_broadcast.english: PRIORITY 1: Switchyard trip at Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation. Emergency mobile generators deployed to critical hospital feeders.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଜରୁରୀ ସୂଚନା: Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation ଗ୍ରୀଡ୍ ସବ୍‌ଷ୍ଟେସନରେ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ ସରବରାହ ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଛି। ଡାକ୍ତରଖାନା ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ଜରୁରୀ ଜେନେରେଟର ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: प्राथमिकता 1: Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation ग्रिड सबस्टेशन में बिजली आपूर्ति बाधित। अस्पतालों के लिए आपातकालीन मोबाइल जनरेटर रवाना किए गए हैं।

directives.failure_mode: Hospital operating on emergency diesel fuel; primary highway corridor threatened by surge inundation.
directives.recommended_action: Reroute fuel replenishment and high-axle ambulances away from submerged coastal routes. Utilize high-elevation inland bypass (Gop-Nimapada corridor). Preemptively stage oxygen refills on upper floor triage wards.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Maintains continuous ICU and neonatal power; guarantees uninterrupted life-support for over 450 in-patients.

vernacular_broadcast.english: MEDICAL ALERT: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) backup power active. Logistics fuel convoys rerouted via inland high-elevation bypass.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଚିକିତ୍ସା ସତର୍କତା: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) ଜରୁରୀକାଳୀନ ଜେନେରେଟରରେ ଚାଲୁଛି। ଇନ୍ଧନ ଗାଡ଼ିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବନ୍ୟାମୁକ୍ତ ଉଚ୍ଚ ରାସ୍ତା ଦେଇ ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: चिकित्सा अलर्ट: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) बैकअप पावर पर चल रहा है। ईंधन के टैंकरों को बाढ़-मुक्त वैकल्पिक मार्ग से भेजा जा रहा है।

directives.failure_mode: Marine Drive SH-13 impassable due to 1.5m+ coastal surge wash-over. Low-lying fishing settlements at risk.
directives.recommended_action: Halt all civilian vehicular transit along SH-13 immediately. Direct SDRF high-clearance inflatable rescue craft to Chandrabhaga and Astaranga coastal refuge pockets.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Prevents vehicle stranding in surge velocity channels; safely secures 5,000+ coastal residents inside stilted concrete shelters.

vernacular_broadcast.english: EVACUATION NOTICE: Marine Drive highway submerged. Use designated inland elevated trails to reach Chandrabhaga Shelter.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରଣ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ: ସାମୁଦ୍ରିକ ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଜୁଆର ପାଣି ପଶିଛି। ନିକଟସ୍ଥ ବାତ୍ୟା ଆଶ୍ରୟସ୍ଥଳୀକୁ ତୁରନ୍ତ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: निकासी चेतावनी: मरीन ड्राइव मार्ग जलमग्न है। तुरंत नजदीकी पक्के चक्रवात आश्रय स्थल में शरण लें।

directives.recommended_action: Isolate 33kV outdoor switchyard busbars at Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation to prevent short-circuit explosion. Mobilize 500kVA mobile diesel generators from Cuttack Disaster Reserve Depot to downstream healthcare facilities.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Prevents catastrophic transformer blowout; saves estimated 4 to 6 weeks of post-cyclone grid rebuilding time.

vernacular_broadcast.english: PRIORITY 1: Switchyard trip at Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation. Emergency mobile generators deployed to critical hospital feeders.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଜରୁରୀ ସୂଚନା: Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation ଗ୍ରୀଡ୍ ସବ୍‌ଷ୍ଟେସନରେ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ ସରବରାହ ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଛି। ଡାକ୍ତରଖାନା ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ଜରୁରୀ ଜେନେରେଟର ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: प्राथमिकता 1: Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation ग्रिड सबस्टेशन में बिजली आपूर्ति बाधित। अस्पतालों के लिए आपातकालीन मोबाइल जनरेटर रवाना किए गए हैं।

directives.failure_mode: Hospital operating on emergency diesel fuel; primary highway corridor threatened by surge inundation.
directives.recommended_action: Reroute fuel replenishment and high-axle ambulances away from submerged coastal routes. Utilize high-elevation inland bypass (Gop-Nimapada corridor). Preemptively stage oxygen refills on upper floor triage wards.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Maintains continuous ICU and neonatal power; guarantees uninterrupted life-support for over 450 in-patients.

vernacular_broadcast.english: MEDICAL ALERT: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) backup power active. Logistics fuel convoys rerouted via inland high-elevation bypass.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଚିକିତ୍ସା ସତର୍କତା: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) ଜରୁରୀକାଳୀନ ଜେନେରେଟରରେ ଚାଲୁଛି। ଇନ୍ଧନ ଗାଡ଼ିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବନ୍ୟାମୁକ୍ତ ଉଚ୍ଚ ରାସ୍ତା ଦେଇ ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: चिकित्सा अलर्ट: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) बैकअप पावर पर चल रहा है। ईंधन के टैंकरों को बाढ़-मुक्त वैकल्पिक मार्ग से भेजा जा रहा है।

directives.failure_mode: Marine Drive SH-13 impassable due to 1.5m+ coastal surge wash-over. Low-lying fishing settlements at risk.
directives.recommended_action: Halt all civilian vehicular transit along SH-13 immediately. Direct SDRF high-clearance inflatable rescue craft to Chandrabhaga and Astaranga coastal refuge pockets.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Prevents vehicle stranding in surge velocity channels; safely secures 5,000+ coastal residents inside stilted concrete shelters.

vernacular_broadcast.english: EVACUATION NOTICE: Marine Drive highway submerged. Use designated inland elevated trails to reach Chandrabhaga Shelter.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରଣ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ: ସାମୁଦ୍ରିକ ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଜୁଆର ପାଣି ପଶିଛି। ନିକଟସ୍ଥ ବାତ୍ୟା ଆଶ୍ରୟସ୍ଥଳୀକୁ ତୁରନ୍ତ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: निकासी चेतावनी: मरीन ड्राइव मार्ग जलमग्न है। तुरंत नजदीकी पक्के चक्रवात आश्रय स्थल में शरण लें।

directives.failure_mode: Complete de-energization of primary transmission feeder. 3 substations tripped due to surge/wind.
directives.recommended_action: Isolate 33kV outdoor switchyard busbars at Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation to prevent short-circuit explosion. Mobilize 500kVA mobile diesel generators from Cuttack Disaster Reserve Depot to downstream healthcare facilities.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Prevents catastrophic transformer blowout; saves estimated 4 to 6 weeks of post-cyclone grid rebuilding time.

vernacular_broadcast.english: PRIORITY 1: Switchyard trip at Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation. Emergency mobile generators deployed to critical hospital feeders.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଜରୁରୀ ସୂଚନା: Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation ଗ୍ରୀଡ୍ ସବ୍‌ଷ୍ଟେସନରେ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ ସରବରାହ ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଛି। ଡାକ୍ତରଖାନା ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ଜରୁରୀ ଜେନେରେଟର ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: प्राथमिकता 1: Puri 132/33kV Main Grid Substation ग्रिड सबस्टेशन में बिजली आपूर्ति बाधित। अस्पतालों के लिए आपातकालीन मोबाइल जनरेटर रवाना किए गए हैं।

directives.failure_mode: Hospital operating on emergency diesel fuel; primary highway corridor threatened by surge inundation.
directives.recommended_action: Reroute fuel replenishment and high-axle ambulances away from submerged coastal routes. Utilize high-elevation inland bypass (Gop-Nimapada corridor). Preemptively stage oxygen refills on upper floor triage wards.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Maintains continuous ICU and neonatal power; guarantees uninterrupted life-support for over 450 in-patients.

vernacular_broadcast.english: MEDICAL ALERT: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) backup power active. Logistics fuel convoys rerouted via inland high-elevation bypass.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଚିକିତ୍ସା ସତର୍କତା: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) ଜରୁରୀକାଳୀନ ଜେନେରେଟରରେ ଚାଲୁଛି। ଇନ୍ଧନ ଗାଡ଼ିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବନ୍ୟାମୁକ୍ତ ଉଚ୍ଚ ରାସ୍ତା ଦେଇ ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: चिकित्सा अलर्ट: Puri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) बैकअप पावर पर चल रहा है। ईंधन के टैंकरों को बाढ़-मुक्त वैकल्पिक मार्ग से भेजा जा रहा है।

directives.failure_mode: Marine Drive SH-13 impassable due to 1.5m+ coastal surge wash-over. Low-lying fishing settlements at risk.
directives.recommended_action: Halt all civilian vehicular transit along SH-13 immediately. Direct SDRF high-clearance inflatable rescue craft to Chandrabhaga and Astaranga coastal refuge pockets.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Prevents vehicle stranding in surge velocity channels; safely secures 5,000+ coastal residents inside stilted concrete shelters.

vernacular_broadcast.english: EVACUATION NOTICE: Marine Drive highway submerged. Use designated inland elevated trails to reach Chandrabhaga Shelter.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରଣ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ: ସାମୁଦ୍ରିକ ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଜୁଆର ପାଣି ପଶିଛି। ନିକଟସ୍ଥ ବାତ୍ୟା ଆଶ୍ରୟସ୍ଥଳୀକୁ ତୁରନ୍ତ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: निकासी चेतावनी: मरीन ड्राइव मार्ग जलमग्न है। तुरंत नजदीकी पक्के चक्रवात आश्रय स्थल में शरण लें।

vernacular_broadcast.hindi: निकासी चेतावनी: मरीन ड्राइव मार्ग जलमग्न है। तुरंत नजदीकी पक्के चक्रवात आश्रय स्थल में शरण लें।

timeline.description: LANDFALL at Puri. Peak surge of +3.5m MSL. Complete grid disruption.

directives.failure_mode: Complete de-energization of primary transmission feeder. 3 substations tripped due to surge/wind.
directives.recommended_action: Isolate 33kV outdoor switchyard busbars at Paradip Port 132/33kV Substation to prevent short-circuit explosion. Mobilize 500kVA mobile diesel generators from Cuttack Disaster Reserve Depot to downstream healthcare facilities.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Prevents catastrophic transformer blowout; saves estimated 4 to 6 weeks of post-cyclone grid rebuilding time.

vernacular_broadcast.english: PRIORITY 1: Switchyard trip at Paradip Port 132/33kV Substation. Emergency mobile generators deployed to critical hospital feeders.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଜରୁରୀ ସୂଚନା: Paradip Port 132/33kV Substation ଗ୍ରୀଡ୍ ସବ୍‌ଷ୍ଟେସନରେ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ ସରବରାହ ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଛି। ଡାକ୍ତରଖାନା ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ଜରୁରୀ ଜେନେରେଟର ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: प्राथमिकता 1: Paradip Port 132/33kV Substation ग्रिड सबस्टेशन में बिजली आपूर्ति बाधित। अस्पतालों के लिए आपातकालीन मोबाइल जनरेटर रवाना किए गए हैं।

directives.failure_mode: Hospital operating on emergency diesel fuel; primary highway corridor threatened by surge inundation.
directives.recommended_action: Reroute fuel replenishment and high-axle ambulances away from submerged coastal routes. Utilize high-elevation inland bypass (Gop-Nimapada corridor). Preemptively stage oxygen refills on upper floor triage wards.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Maintains continuous ICU and neonatal power; guarantees uninterrupted life-support for over 450 in-patients.

vernacular_broadcast.english: MEDICAL ALERT: Nimapada Sub-Divisional Hospital backup power active. Logistics fuel convoys rerouted via inland high-elevation bypass.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଚିକିତ୍ସା ସତର୍କତା: Nimapada Sub-Divisional Hospital ଜରୁରୀକାଳୀନ ଜେନେରେଟରରେ ଚାଲୁଛି। ଇନ୍ଧନ ଗାଡ଼ିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବନ୍ୟାମୁକ୍ତ ଉଚ୍ଚ ରାସ୍ତା ଦେଇ ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: चिकित्सा अलर्ट: Nimapada Sub-Divisional Hospital बैकअप पावर पर चल रहा है। ईंधन के टैंकरों को बाढ़-मुक्त वैकल्पिक मार्ग से भेजा जा रहा है।

directives.failure_mode: Marine Drive SH-13 impassable due to 1.5m+ coastal surge wash-over. Low-lying fishing settlements at risk.
directives.recommended_action: Halt all civilian vehicular transit along SH-13 immediately. Direct SDRF high-clearance inflatable rescue craft to Chandrabhaga and Astaranga coastal refuge pockets.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Prevents vehicle stranding in surge velocity channels; safely secures 5,000+ coastal residents inside stilted concrete shelters.

directives.counterfactual_impact: Maintains continuous ICU and neonatal power; guarantees uninterrupted life-support for over 450 in-patients.

vernacular_broadcast.english: MEDICAL ALERT: Paradip Port Trust Hospital backup power active. Logistics fuel convoys rerouted via inland high-elevation bypass.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଚିକିତ୍ସା ସତର୍କତା: Paradip Port Trust Hospital ଜରୁରୀକାଳୀନ ଜେନେରେଟରରେ ଚାଲୁଛି। ଇନ୍ଧନ ଗାଡ଼ିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବନ୍ୟାମୁକ୍ତ ଉଚ୍ଚ ରାସ୍ତା ଦେଇ ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: चिकित्सा अलर्ट: Paradip Port Trust Hospital बैकअप पावर पर चल रहा है। ईंधन के टैंकरों को बाढ़-मुक्त वैकल्पिक मार्ग से भेजा जा रहा है।

directives.failure_mode: Marine Drive SH-13 impassable due to 1.5m+ coastal surge wash-over. Low-lying fishing settlements at risk.
directives.recommended_action: Halt all civilian vehicular transit along SH-13 immediately. Direct SDRF high-clearance inflatable rescue craft to Chandrabhaga and Astaranga coastal refuge pockets.
directives.counterfactual_impact: Prevents vehicle stranding in surge velocity channels; safely secures 5,000+ coastal residents inside stilted concrete shelters.

vernacular_broadcast.english: EVACUATION NOTICE: Marine Drive highway submerged. Use designated inland elevated trails to reach Chandrabhaga Shelter.
vernacular_broadcast.odia: ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରଣ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ: ସାମୁଦ୍ରିକ ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଜୁଆର ପାଣି ପଶିଛି। ନିକଟସ୍ଥ ବାତ୍ୟା ଆଶ୍ରୟସ୍ଥଳୀକୁ ତୁରନ୍ତ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: निकासी चेतावनी: मरीन ड्राइव मार्ग जलमग्न है। तुरंत नजदीकी पक्के चक्रवात आश्रय स्थल में शरण लें।

timeline.description: Passing over Paradip & Kendrapada; storm surge receding at Puri

directives.failure_mode: Complete de-energization of primary transmission feeder. 1 substations tripped due to surge/wind.

directives.counterfactual_impact: Prevents catastrophic transformer blowout; saves estimated 4 to 6 weeks of post-cyclone grid rebuilding time.

directives.recommended_action: Halt all civilian vehicular transit along SH-13 immediately. Direct SDRF high-clearance inflatable rescue craft to Chandrabhaga and Astaranga coastal refuge pockets.

vernacular_broadcast.english: EVACUATION NOTICE: Marine Drive highway submerged. Use designated inland elevated trails to reach Chandrabhaga Shelter.

vernacular_broadcast.odia: ଜରୁରୀ ସୂଚନା: Astaranga 33/11kV Coastal Substation ଗ୍ରୀଡ୍ ସବ୍‌ଷ୍ଟେସନରେ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ ସରବରାହ ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଛି। ଡାକ୍ତରଖାନା ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ଜରୁରୀ ଜେନେରେଟର ପଠାଯାଉଛି।
vernacular_broadcast.hindi: प्राथमिकता 1: Astaranga 33/11kV Coastal Substation ग्रिड सबस्टेशन में बिजली आपूर्ति बाधित। अस्पतालों के लिए आपातकालीन मोबाइल जनरेटर रवाना किए गए हैं।
